name: note_is_taken_away_by_its_text
why: REPORT 8CD843 N32, round 8 (27/10/2026). «note» counts the notes of the sheet and those of the views apart (67 and 7 on the clip drawing), because adding them «would make an empty drawing look full»; «delete_annotation» added them (75 -> 74). Two operations of the same family counting the same thing in two ways.
defect_caught: A note taken away that is counted together with the title block notes, so that the answer cannot say where it was. The case puts a note on the sheet and takes it away by its text, and asks for the two counts apart and for how many notes went: one.

expect.why: a view attaches to the path of the part
the bench follows the new document (entry GT0)
views that hold no note: «zero in the views» is then a measure, not a lack of views
the note to take away is on the sheet
said only after the sheet is walked again and nothing answers to the text
a note, found by its exact text
where the note was, as «note» says it
THE TWO COUNTS APART, as «note» gives them: the views held no note
THE MEASURE OF THE THING: one note fewer, counted on the sheet and in the views, not the answer of DeleteSelection2
